translations.web: he said to them, “Make room, because the girl isn’t dead, but sleeping.” They were ridiculing him.
translations.bsb: “Go away,” He told them. “The girl is not dead, but asleep.” And they laughed at Him.
translations.kjv: He said unto them, Give place: for the maid is not dead, but sleepeth. And they laughed him to scorn.
